messages.author: 7a97c986864bf6d6
messages.subject: constrain for quadratic function > 0 not working
parts:
Hello,

for my gamma(a,b) I am fitting two quadratic functions

a = aa1 * x + aa2 * x^2 + aa3
b = ...

I need them to be > 0 to ensure stability for stan (a, b must be > 0)

However I get the following messages. I attach data and script.


model="
data{
int N;
int P;
vector[P] slices;
vector[P] slices2;
vector[N] y[P];

}

parameters{
  real<lower=0> cc1;
  real<lower=0> cc2;
  real<lower=0> aa2;
  real<lower=0> bb2;
  real<upper=sqrt(4*aa2*cc1)> aa1;
  real<upper=sqrt(4*bb2*cc2)> bb1;

}
transformed parameters{
  vector[P] a;
  vector[P] b;

  a = aa1 * slices + aa2 * slices2 + cc1;
  b = bb1 * slices + bb2 * slices2 + cc2;
}
model{
  cc1 ~ cauchy(0,2.5);
  aa2 ~ cauchy(0,2.5);
  bb2 ~ cauchy(0,2.5);

 for(p in 1:P) target += gamma_lpdf(y[p] | a[p],b[p]);    
}
"

fit <- rstan:::stan(
  model_code=model,
  data = list(N=dim(df)[1], P=length(slices), y=t(df), slices=slices, slices2=slices^2),
  iter=500
)
